questions.question: What is the name of the earliest form of writing known in the Indian subcontinent?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indus Script**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indus Script** is the earliest form of writing known in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It was used by the Indus Valley Civilization, which flourished around 2600 to 1900 BCE in what is now Pakistan and northwest India.
 
• The script is found on various artifacts, including seals, pottery, and tablets.
 
• Despite numerous attempts, the Indus Script remains undeciphered, and its exact nature and function are still subjects of research and debate.
 
• It consists of numerous symbols, some of which are repeated frequently, suggesting a complex system of writing or proto-writing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indus Valley Civilization** is one of the world's oldest urban civilizations, along with Mesopotamia and Ancient Egypt.
 
• The major sites of this civilization include Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Dholavira, and Lothal.
 
• The civilization is noted for its advanced urban planning, architecture, and social organization.
 
• The discovery of the Indus Script has provided valuable insights into the culture and practices of the Indus Valley people, despite its undeciphered state.
 
• Efforts to decode the script involve comparative analysis with other ancient scripts and languages, but no definitive translation has been achieved so far.

questions.question: Marked price of a chair is Rs. 2000. After giving two successive discounts of 20 percent and x percent, the chair is sold for Rs. 1400. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the chair = Rs. 2000

Selling price after two discounts = Rs. 1400

First discount = 20%

Second discount = x%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

**Calculation:**

Let the second discount be x%

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

1400 = 2000 × (1 - 0.20) × (1 - x/100)

1400 = 2000 × 0.80 × (1 - x/100)

1400 = 1600 × (1 - x/100)

⇒ 1400 / 1600 = 1 - x/100

⇒ 0.875 = 1 - x/100

⇒ x/100 = 1 - 0.875

⇒ x/100 = 0.125

⇒ x = 0.125 × 100

⇒ x = 12.5

**The value of x is 12.5 percent.**
